name: codex-efficiency-radar-repository
description: Codex Efficiency Radar plugin and optional Windows/macOS selector overlay.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter codex-efficiency-radar run test && pnpm --filter @codex-efficiency-radar/windows-overlay run test
scripts.check:scripts: node --check scripts/install.mjs && node --check scripts/uninstall.mjs && node --check plugins/codex-efficiency-radar/scripts/install-selector-overlay.mjs && node --check plugins/codex-efficiency-radar/scripts/uninstall-selector-overlay.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run check:scripts && pnpm --filter codex-efficiency-radar run check:source && pnpm --filter @codex-efficiency-radar/windows-overlay run check && node scripts/verify-publication.mjs
